parameters.query:
WITH gate AS (
  SELECT governance.acquire_runtime_gate('agent_reporting') AS reliability_gate
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN (reliability_gate->>'allowed')::boolean
    THEN governance.execute_agent_report_request_v2($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,$6::jsonb)
  ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'status','rejected',
    'reason','CIRCUIT_OPEN',
    'retry_after',reliability_gate->>'retry_after'
  )
END AS agent_result
FROM gate;

nodes.name: VAL | Use LLM Intent?
nodes.notes: Optional LLM gate. The model interprets intent only; deterministic controls still authorize execution.

nodes.name: AI | Prepare Groq Intent Request
nodes.notes: Builds a bounded Groq intent prompt from the authenticated manager question. No SQL, credentials, or authorization are delegated to AI.

nodes.name: AI | Groq Interpret Intent
nodes.notes: Optional Groq intent call using encrypted Header Auth. Invalid/failed output is never trusted as authorization.

nodes.name: VAL | Normalize Groq Intent
nodes.notes: Schema-checks Groq output and maps it into Agent V2 structured_intent. Invalid output falls back to deterministic interpretation.
